Use as GM-only texture unless table play earns it. board Goldspire Logistics A forgettable freight-coordination concern with plain grey seals and paperwork nobody remembers seeing twice. Keeping everything moving. A dull freight mark, a grey seal, and a name too boring to remember keep Goldspire Logistics nearly invisible. Goldspire Logistics does not look powerful. That is the trick of it. A grey seal appears on crate corners, approval slips, and route papers, always in the same modest ink, always small enough to miss if you are looking for a villain with a banner. The mark is almost nothing: grey ink, a square crate, a practical little stamp in the corner. It has the confidence of something that does not need to advertise.
